ext_name.message: Macify - Gorgeous Aerial Videos as Your New Tab

ext_description.message: Transform Chrome's new tab into macOS's gorgeous aerial screensaver videos.

options_video_reverse_proxy_warning.message: The reverse proxy runs on author-hosted infrastructure with no long-term availability guarantee. For a stable setup, trust Apple's certificate manually or run a local Apache server (see help below).

options_video_shuffle_scope_hint.message: If the selected category has no videos in the current source, all videos will play instead.

error_video_apple.message: Couldn't load videos from Apple's server. Try enabling the reverse proxy in settings, or trust sylvan.apple.com's certificate manually.

error_video_local.message: Couldn't reach the local video server. Check the URL in settings.

error_video_local_empty.message: Local server reachable but no .mov / .mp4 files found.

options_weather_city_hint.message: Type a city name (English works best) and press Enter or click Save. We verify against the weather service before saving.

options_weather_city_invalid.message: Couldn't find that city. Try a more standard name.

topsites_empty.message: No top sites yet — visit some pages first.

options_display_hint.message: Choose what appears on the new tab page.

options_location_hint.message: Used by Time (Sky Arc) and Weather. The city must validate before those features become available.

options_sky_arc_needs_city.message: To enable the Sky Arc clock, validate a city in the Location section first.

options_sky_arc_time_zone.message: The Sky Arc clock displays time in the selected city's local timezone.

options_weather_needs_city.message: To enable Weather, validate a city in the Location section first.

video_apple_help_title.message: Why might Apple's server need extra setup?

video_apple_help_intro.message: Chrome doesn't always trust Apple's sylvan.apple.com certificate, so direct video loading may fail. Two ways to make it work:

video_apple_help_option1_body.message: Tick the "Use reverse proxy" checkbox above. Macify will route requests through a Cloudflare Worker that handles the certificate dance for you. Zero local setup.

video_apple_help_option2_body_post.message: in Chrome once. You'll see a security warning — click Advanced, then "Proceed to sylvan.apple.com (unsafe)". Chrome remembers your trust and direct connection works from then on.

video_local_help_title.message: Set up a local Apache server (one-time)

video_local_macos_only.message: Note: the steps below use macOS's built-in Apache. On other platforms, any HTTP server with directory listing and CORS enabled will work — adapt accordingly.

video_local_step1.message: Run this command in Terminal to configure macOS's built-in Apache to serve the Aerial videos. It asks for your password once.

video_local_step2.message: Download the videos. There are two ways:

video_local_step2_manual_body.message: Open System Settings → Screen Saver → Aerial. Click each video you want to download. Each is 500 MB – 1 GB; downloads can take a while and may need retries.

video_local_step2_script_body.message: Run this command in Terminal and follow the on-screen prompts. The script reports the estimated size and your free disk space before asking for confirmation.

video_local_step3_post.message: ) should now serve your downloaded videos.

donate_explainer.message: Macify is free and open source. The Apple-server reverse proxy runs on my personal Cloudflare account. If you find it useful, a small sponsorship goes a long way.

proxy_advisory_message.message: The reverse proxy isn't guaranteed long-term. Consider switching to Apple direct or a local server.
